## Workflow B · Optimised matching funnel
**Stage 1 – SQL:** hard criteria as JOIN predicates in Postgres (cross-product never leaves the DB)

**Stage 2 – JS:** score, FOIR affordability, keep top-K per user, split clear vs borderline

**Stage 3 – LLM:** only borderline pairs, collapsed into profile buckets, cached across runs, 25 questions per call, hard call budget

Funnel numbers are saved to `upload_batches.match_stats`.

parameters.query: UPDATE upload_batches SET status = 'matching', updated_at = now() WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid RETURNING batch_id::text;

-- STAGE 1 - set-based hard filter inside PostgreSQL.
-- Every numeric/categorical rule is applied as a JOIN predicate, so the
-- users x products cross-product is never materialised in n8n: Postgres
-- returns only the pairs that satisfy all hard criteria, in one round-trip.
-- Pairs come back as compact arrays inside ONE row (not one n8n item per pair),
-- which keeps n8n's per-item overhead out of the hot path.
WITH batch_users AS (
    SELECT user_id, monthly_income, credit_score, age, employment_status
    FROM users
    WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid
),
products AS (
    SELECT product_id, lender, product_name, interest_rate_min, interest_rate_max,
           min_monthly_income, min_credit_score, max_credit_score, min_age, max_age,
           employment_types, max_loan_amount, other_criteria, criteria_source
    FROM loan_products
    WHERE is_active
),
candidates AS (
    SELECT u.user_id, p.product_id, u.monthly_income, u.credit_score, u.age, u.employment_status
    FROM batch_users u
    JOIN products p
      ON  u.monthly_income >= COALESCE(p.min_monthly_income, 0)
      AND u.credit_score BETWEEN COALESCE(p.min_credit_score, 300) AND COALESCE(p.max_credit_score, 900)
      AND u.age          BETWEEN COALESCE(p.min_age, 18)          AND COALESCE(p.max_age, 100)
      AND (p.employment_types IS NULL OR u.employment_status = ANY (p.employment_types))
)
SELECT
    $1::text                                        AS batch_id,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM batch_users)::int         AS users_in_batch,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM products)::int            AS products_active,
    (SELECT count(*) FROM candidates)::int          AS stage1_pairs,
    (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(row_to_json(p)), '[]'::json) FROM products p) AS products,
    (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_array(user_id, product_id, monthly_income,
                                               credit_score, age, employment_status)), '[]'::json)
       FROM candidates)                             AS pairs;

-- STAGE 3a - reuse earlier LLM verdicts for identical (product, profile-bucket) questions.
SELECT cache_key, eligible, reason
FROM llm_decision_cache
WHERE cache_key IN (SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text($1::jsonb));

INSERT INTO llm_decision_cache (cache_key, product_id, eligible, reason, model)
SELECT cache_key, product_id, eligible, reason, model
FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(cache_key text, product_id int, eligible boolean, reason text, model text)
ON CONFLICT (cache_key) DO UPDATE
    SET eligible = EXCLUDED.eligible, reason = EXCLUDED.reason, model = EXCLUDED.model, created_at = now()
RETURNING cache_key;

-- Bulk-insert all matches and close out the batch in a single statement.
-- Re-uploaded users: un-notified matches that no longer qualify are pruned.
WITH incoming AS (
    SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset($2::jsonb)
        AS x(user_id text, product_id int, score numeric, decision_source text, reason text)
),
stale AS (
    DELETE FROM matches m
    USING users u
    WHERE u.user_id = m.user_id AND u.batch_id = $1::uuid AND m.notified_at IS NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incoming i WHERE i.user_id = m.user_id AND i.product_id = m.product_id)
    RETURNING 1
),
saved AS (
    INSERT INTO matches (user_id, product_id, batch_id, score, decision_source, reason)
    SELECT user_id, product_id, $1::uuid, score, decision_source, reason FROM incoming
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO UPDATE
        SET score = EXCLUDED.score, decision_source = EXCLUDED.decision_source,
            reason = EXCLUDED.reason, batch_id = EXCLUDED.batch_id
    RETURNING 1
)
UPDATE upload_batches
SET status = 'matched', match_stats = $3::jsonb, updated_at = now()
WHERE batch_id = $1::uuid
RETURNING batch_id::text, (SELECT count(*) FROM saved)::int AS matches_saved,
          (SELECT count(*) FROM stale)::int AS stale_matches_removed;
